            - Site visit found damage to the station was cause of data outage 
              previously reported.  Following work was performed at approx 
              11:00 (Day=333)

            - Disconnected Leaf Wetness B (canopy sensor)

            - Removed Wind Vane 
 
 
11/13/2003: Equipment Failure: 
 
            - Air Temperature/Relative Humidity Sensor Failed at approx. 
              06:50 (Day=317).  Sensor may be replaced the week of Nov 24.  
 
     - Faulty Temperature/RH data will be removed from database after 
              new sensor is installed.
